title: FP POV of Sound - Fast APM style (showing monitor, mouse and keyboard)
summary: An over-the-shoulder view of StarCraft 2 pro player Sound at a WCS qualifier, showing his monitor, keyboard and mouse. It shows his very fast actions per minute in real time.
why: HN commenters cite it as an example of expert human multitasking and heavy keyboard use with sparing mouse use.

quote.text: Notice that the mouse is only used to select units, issue commands on specific targets, and ocasionally scroll the map.
